page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m8.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance integrates a single NVIDIA GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data hosting. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated AMD EPYC processing cores and entry-level Ada Lovelace GPU acceleration offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring moderate parallel computing power without the overhead of high-end enterprise GPUs. This hardware configuration is suitable for workloads such as small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, graphics rendering, and GPU-accelerated general-purpose computing.
